Game Overview

Factory Builder is a building title where become an industrial tycoon in Factory Builder, mastering production processes from lamp bulbs to flashlight manufacturing. Strategically upgrade technology, reduce costs, and diversify products to expand your empire. Experience idle gameplay where progress continues while you plan the perfect balance of growth, efficiency, and profitability.
